what_to_detect: A candidate spell with affinity for artifacts has a cost_after_adjustment one generic mana lower per artifact its controller controls.
near_miss: A candidate with affinity whose adjusted cost equals its printed cost because its controller controls no artifact.
record_fields: state entities: artifacts the candidate's controller controls

what_to_detect: A candidate spell with several instances of affinity has its cost reduced once per instance.
near_miss: A candidate with one instance of affinity, reduced once.
record_fields: card lines of kind keyword, granted (gen-3)
